scientific_integrity: Proof establishes a strict mean-square dichotomy and explicit leading perturbation coefficient. Finite verifier tests serve only as corroboration. Originality is best-knowledge, not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: One-degree-of-freedom harmonic oscillator, independent state-independent step lengths compactly supported inside (0,2), exact arithmetic, long-time growth indexed by number of steps. No almost-sure exponent, fixed physical-time claim, or uniform joint small-step/noise expansion.
title: Universal mean-square heating from nondegenerate random steps in Verlet integration
